jobs.description_snippet: **Required skills** * Engineering **Why Faculty?** ---------------- We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Within the constraints of a highly regulated industry, we see so much opportunity for impactful innovation and are proud to set the gold-standard for marrying technical excellence with safe deployment. **About the role** ------------------ Join us as a Machine Learning Engineer to deliver bespoke, impactful AI solutions for our diverse Financial Services clients.
